words.engDef: short for absolute value; also the stomach muscles
words.example: The company reported a significant increase in absolute sales figures for the quarter.
words.chinese: 絕對值；總數

words.engDef: on the opposite side of the road
words.example: The office building is located across the street from the train station.
words.chinese: 在...的對街；位於...的另一側

words.engDef: an extra charge on top of the usual price
words.example: Please note that there may be an additional fee for express shipping.
words.chinese: 額外費用；附加費用（通常指超出基本價格的額外收費）

words.engDef: to move a mirror to the right angle
words.example: Before driving, please adjust the mirror to ensure optimal visibility.
words.chinese: 調整鏡子，通常指調整車輛後視鏡或化妝鏡等。

words.engDef: the price of a ticket to travel by air
words.example: The company will reimburse employees for their airfare and accommodation expenses.
words.chinese: 機票費用；航空票價

words.engDef: companies that carry passengers by air
words.example: Several airlines have announced fare reductions for the upcoming holiday season.
words.chinese: 航空公司；航空業

words.engDef: a seat next to the passage in a plane or theatre
words.example: I prefer an aisle seat so I can easily get up to use the restroom.
words.chinese: 機上座位，位於機艙走道旁，方便乘客進出。

words.engDef: beside the edge of the sea or a lake
words.example: The resort is located along the shore, offering stunning ocean views.
words.chinese: 沿著海岸線

words.engDef: desirable or useful features of a building, hotel, or place
words.example: The luxury resort is famous for its exceptional spa and fitness amenities.
words.chinese: （飯店）便利設施，備品

words.engDef: an outdoor place with rides and entertainment
words.example: Our company is considering offering employee discounts to local amusement parks as a team-building activity.
words.chinese: 遊樂園，通常提供各種娛樂設施和活動，吸引遊客。

words.engDef: the fourth month of the year
words.example: The company's annual sales conference is scheduled for April next year.
words.chinese: 四月，一年中的第四個月。
words.rootPrefix: Aprilis (the Roman month, perhaps from aperire to open -- when the buds open)

words.engDef: a building where works of art are displayed
words.example: Our company is planning a corporate event at the art museum next month.
words.chinese: 藝術博物館，通常展示和保存藝術作品，是企業活動中文化交流或商務接待的場所。

words.engDef: places that people enjoy visiting
words.example: The city's main attractions include historical landmarks and vibrant cultural events.
words.chinese: 景點、吸引力（指吸引遊客或投資者的事物）

words.engDef: a car
words.example: The company provides employees with a vehicle allowance to cover the cost of their automobiles.
words.chinese: 汽車；機動車（通常指乘用車，在商務情境中指個人或公司擁有的車輛）

words.engDef: a business that repairs cars
words.example: Our company has a contract with a local automotive repair shop for vehicle maintenance.
words.chinese: 汽車維修店，提供汽車保養、維修及相關服務的商業場所。

words.engDef: the seat at the rear of a car
words.example: The passengers in the backseat were enjoying the scenic route.
words.chinese: 後座（通常指車輛後座）；不重要的角色或意見

words.engDef: the area in an airport where arriving passengers collect luggage
words.example: The travelers proceeded to the baggage claim area after passing customs.
words.chinese: 行李提領處

words.engDef: to have no places or times left available
words.example: I'm sorry, sir, but the conference room is booked up for the entire week.
words.chinese: 已滿額；預訂額滿，無法安排

words.engDef: to be shut so that vehicles cannot pass
words.example: Due to the marathon, Main Street will be closed to traffic from 7 AM to 12 PM.
words.chinese: 因施工或活動等原因，對車輛交通限制或禁止通行。

words.engDef: to be delayed
words.example: The flight was held up due to severe weather conditions.
words.chinese: 因故延遲；被耽擱

words.engDef: to be delayed because of heavy traffic
words.example: I'm sorry for the delay; I was held up in traffic this morning.
words.chinese: 因交通延誤而耽擱；因塞車而停滯

words.engDef: to be waiting in a queue
words.example: Please be in line at the security checkpoint to ensure a smooth boarding process.
words.chinese: 排隊等候；在隊伍中

words.engDef: to be away travelling
words.example: Mr. Lee is on a business trip to Tokyo next week to negotiate a new contract.
words.chinese: 正在旅行；出差

words.engDef: to have your vehicle pulled away by an official truck
words.example: Your vehicle will be towed away if you park in a restricted zone.
words.chinese: 因違規停車而被拖吊

words.engDef: an instrument with two eyepieces for seeing distant things
words.example: The tour guide recommended bringing binoculars to better observe the wildlife during the safari.
words.chinese: 雙筒望遠鏡；觀景鏡
words.rootPrefix: bini (two at a time) + oculus (an eye) + -ar

words.engDef: to get on an aircraft
words.example: Passengers are requested to board the flight 30 minutes prior to departure.
words.chinese: 登上飛機；搭乘飛機

words.engDef: the place in an airport where passengers get on a plane
words.example: Please proceed to boarding gate 42 for your flight to New York.
words.chinese: 登機口，指旅客在機場搭乘飛機的指定位置。

words.engDef: a pass that authorizes a passenger to board a plane or ship
words.example: Please show your boarding pass and national passport to the gate agent.
words.chinese: 登機證

words.engDef: the time at which passengers may get on a plane
words.example: Please arrive at the gate at least 30 minutes before your boarding time.
words.chinese: 登機時間，指旅客應在機場辦理登機手續並準備登機的時間。

words.engDef: an area of water such as a lake or sea
words.example: The company is exploring the possibility of transporting goods by water, utilizing the nearby body of water.
words.chinese: 水域，指廣闊的水體，例如湖泊、河流、海洋等。

words.engDef: a park where many kinds of plants are grown and studied
words.example: Our company is sponsoring a guided tour of the botanical garden for employees and their families.
words.chinese: 植物園，專門展示和研究各種植物的園區，通常用於教育、研究或休閒目的。

words.engDef: travelling towards a particular place
words.example: The shipment is bound for Singapore and is expected to arrive next week.
words.chinese: 正前往；駛向（某地）

words.engDef: to fasten your seatbelt
words.example: Before we start the journey, please buckle up your seatbelts.
words.chinese: 繫好安全帶（通常指汽車安全帶），以確保乘車安全。

words.engDef: a place where buses stop for passengers
words.example: The delivery driver needs to wait at the bus stop to pick up the package.
words.chinese: 公車站牌；公車停靠站

words.engDef: a class of air travel with better seats and service
words.example: The company policy allows employees to fly business class on international trips.
words.chinese: 商務艙，提供更寬敞的座位、額外服務和設施的飛機座位等級。

words.engDef: a road with a lot of traffic and people
words.example: Due to the busy street, pedestrians are advised to use the crosswalks.
words.chinese: 繁忙的街道，通常指交通繁忙、人潮眾多的街道。

words.engDef: the calling off of something that was arranged
words.example: Due to unforeseen circumstances, we regret to inform you of the flight cancellation.
words.chinese: 取消（預訂、合約等），取消通知

words.engDef: the business of hiring out cars for short periods
words.example: Our company offers discounted car rentals for business travelers.
words.chinese: 汽車租賃；租車服務

words.engDef: an arrangement where people share a car to travel
words.example: To reduce our carbon footprint, the company encourages employees to carpool to work.
words.chinese: 共乘；拼車（多數人共同使用同一輛車，以節省交通費用或減少環境污染）

words.engDef: the bag you take with you into the aircraft cabin
words.example: Please ensure your carry-on baggage meets the airline's size and weight restrictions.
words.chinese: 隨身行李，通常指符合航空公司規定尺寸且可放置於機艙內的手提行李。

words.engDef: an aircraft hired for a particular group or trip
words.example: The company arranged a charter plane to transport all employees to the conference in Hawaii.
words.chinese: 包機航班；為特定團體或公司租用的專用客機。

words.engDef: to report your arrival at a hotel or airport
words.example: Please check in at the front desk upon arrival.
words.chinese: （在飯店、機場等）辦理入住；（系統）登入

words.engDef: a small car that is economical to run
words.example: Our company is considering purchasing a fleet of compact cars to reduce fuel costs.
words.chinese: 小型汽車，通常指車身尺寸較小、燃油效率較高的汽車。

words.engDef: a separate section inside a vehicle or container
words.example: Please store your carry-on luggage in the overhead compartment.
words.chinese: 隔間; (火車等的)小客房,小包廂; 艙; 箱

words.engDef: a hotel staff member who assists guests with bookings, reservations, and information
words.example: The hotel concierge helped us secure front-row tickets to the sold-out Broadway show.
words.chinese: （飯店）禮賓人員，服務台職員

words.engDef: a large open area in a station or airport
words.example: Passengers crowded the concourse, waiting for their delayed flights.
words.chinese: （車站、機場等）大廳、候客區；人群
words.rootPrefix: con- (together) + cursus (a running) -> where the crowds run together

words.engDef: too full of traffic or people to move easily
words.example: The highway is heavily congested during rush hour, so allow extra travel time.
words.chinese: 擁塞的；阻塞的，交通繁忙的
words.rootPrefix: con- (together) + gest (to carry, from gerere) -> carried together into a heap

words.engDef: the state of being blocked by too much traffic
words.example: Due to heavy congestion on the highway, the delivery is expected to be delayed.
words.chinese: 交通擁塞；阻塞；（網路）擁塞

words.engDef: a second flight you take to reach your destination
words.example: Due to the flight cancellation, I had to book a connecting flight with a longer layover.
words.chinese: 轉機航班；中轉航班（指旅客需要換機才能到達最終目的地的航班）

words.engDef: hit something violently; also stopped working suddenly
words.example: The cargo plane crashed during the storm, resulting in significant delays.
words.chinese: 撞擊、墜毀（指交通工具或設備等突然且劇烈的撞擊，導致損壞或停止運作）

words.engDef: to walk from one side of the road to the other
words.example: Please be careful when you cross the street; traffic is heavy during rush hour.
words.chinese: 穿越馬路；橫過馬路

words.engDef: the marked place where people may cross a road
words.example: Pedestrians must use the crosswalk when crossing the street to ensure their safety.
words.chinese: 行人穿越道，通常在道路上繪製的標線，用以確保行人安全穿越馬路。

words.engDef: full of too many people
words.example: The train was so crowded during the morning rush hour that passengers had to stand.
words.chinese: 擁擠的；人潮眾多的，形容空間或場所因人數過多而變得狹窄不適。

words.engDef: a person whose job is to help and deal with customers
words.example: Our company is hiring several customer service representatives to handle increased call volume.
words.chinese: 客戶服務代表，負責處理客戶諮詢、投訴及提供支援的專業人員。

words.engDef: a person who rides a bicycle
words.example: The company is promoting cycling to work as a sustainable transportation option for employees.
words.chinese: 自行車騎士；騎自行車的人

words.engDef: leaving a place, especially to start a journey
words.example: The departing flight to London is scheduled for 7:00 AM.
words.chinese: 即將離開；啟程的

words.engDef: leaves a place to start a journey
words.example: The flight departs from Gate 12 at 10:00 AM.
words.chinese: 出發；離開

words.engDef: the time at which a vehicle leaves
words.example: Please confirm the departure time for flight BA249 to London.
words.chinese: 出發時間，指交通工具（如飛機、火車、巴士）預計離開的時刻。

words.engDef: the place someone or something is going to
words.example: Our company is expanding its operations and exploring new international destinations.
words.chinese: 目的地；目標地點
words.rootPrefix: de- (completely) + stinare (to make firm) + -ation -> the place fixed on

words.engDef: a longer route taken because the direct way is blocked
words.example: Due to road construction, we had to take a detour, which added an hour to our delivery time.
words.chinese: 繞道；替代路線（通常因為道路施工或障礙物而產生的），指從原定路線偏離，走另一條路徑。

words.engDef: to guide vehicles so they move safely
words.example: The police officer was directing traffic around the accident site to ensure public safety.
words.chinese: 引導交通；指揮交通

words.engDef: to get off a ship, plane, or train
words.example: All passengers are requested to disembark the cruise ship in an orderly fashion.
words.chinese: （乘客、貨物等）下船、下車；離船、離車

words.engDef: a heavy fall of rain
words.example: The heavy downpour delayed the delivery of the goods, causing a backlog at the warehouse.
words.chinese: 傾盆大雨；驟雨

words.engDef: a bridge that can be raised to let boats pass
words.example: The security team lowered the drawbridge to allow the delivery trucks to enter the facility.
words.chinese: 可升降的吊橋，通常用於控制交通或保護建築物。

words.engDef: to leave in a vehicle
words.example: After loading the shipment, the truck drove off towards the distribution center.
words.chinese: 開車離開；駛離（通常指離開停車場或特定地點）

words.engDef: to arrive somewhere in a vehicle; also to raise prices
words.example: I'll drive up to the warehouse to pick up the shipment this afternoon.
words.chinese: （指開車）前往某地取貨或接送；（指開車）快速前往某處

words.engDef: an instruction telling a driver which way to go
words.example: Could you please provide driving directions to the conference venue?
words.chinese: 行車指示；導航方向

words.engDef: to take someone to a place and leave them there
words.example: The delivery driver will drop off the package at your office tomorrow morning.
words.chinese: 送（某人或物）至指定地點並離開；卸貨

words.engDef: sold without the usual taxes on goods
words.example: Passengers can purchase duty-free goods at the airport before their flight.
words.chinese: 免稅的；免關稅的（通常指在機場、船上或邊境地區銷售的商品）

words.engDef: a shop selling goods without the usual taxes
words.example: Many international travelers make a point of visiting the duty-free shop at the airport to purchase souvenirs.
words.chinese: 免稅商店，通常位於機場、港口或邊境附近，允許旅客在不繳稅的情況下購買商品。

words.engDef: the Christian festival celebrating the resurrection
words.example: Due to the Easter holiday, our office will be closed from April 1st to April 2nd.
words.chinese: 復活節，一個基督教節日，通常也指復活節假期。

words.engDef: a short journey made for pleasure
words.example: The company organized an excursion to a local museum to promote team bonding.
words.chinese: 短途旅行或觀光活動，通常是為了休閒或學習目的。
words.rootPrefix: ex- (out) + curs (to run) + -ion -> a running out

words.engDef: the spending of more money than is sensible
words.example: The company is trying to cut down on extravagance in travel expenses.
words.chinese: 過度浪費；不必要的開銷

words.engDef: to do up a belt or strap securely
words.example: Please fasten your seatbelt before the plane takes off.
words.chinese: 將帶子固定；繫緊帶子

words.engDef: the best and most expensive class of travel
words.example: The company upgraded our flights to first class for the important client meeting.
words.chinese: 頭等艙；（品質、等級）一流的

words.engDef: a member of the cabin crew on an aircraft
words.example: The flight attendants demonstrated excellent customer service throughout the long-haul flight.
words.chinese: 機組人員，負責乘客安全、服務及協助飛機運作的空乘人員。

words.engDef: a narrow path for people to walk along
words.example: The hotel is located a short distance from the footpath leading to the scenic overlook.
words.chinese: 人行道；行人專用小路（通常位於鄉村或郊區，用於散步或慢跑）

words.engDef: entry without any charge
words.example: The museum offers free admission to all students with valid ID.
words.chinese: 免費入場；無需支付入場費

words.engDef: the gases released when fuel is burned
words.example: The company is investing in new technologies to reduce fuel emissions from its fleet of vehicles.
words.chinese: 燃料排放，指車輛或其他設備燃燒燃料所產生的廢氣或污染物。

words.engDef: using little fuel for the distance travelled
words.example: Our company is committed to purchasing fuel-efficient vehicles to reduce our carbon footprint.
words.chinese: 節省燃油的；省油的，指車輛或設備在消耗燃料的同時，能以較高的效率運作。

words.engDef: fuel for vehicles; also a substance that is not solid or liquid
words.example: The company is investing in alternative fuel sources, such as natural gas, to reduce carbon emissions.
words.chinese: 天然氣；燃料氣體

words.engDef: a place where you buy fuel for a vehicle
words.example: The delivery truck needs to stop at a gas station to refuel before reaching the warehouse.
words.chinese: 加油站，提供燃料及相關服務的場所。

words.engDef: to travel in someone else's vehicle
words.example: I need to get a ride to the airport tomorrow morning.
words.chinese: 搭乘交通工具（通常是他人提供）

words.engDef: to buy a ticket; also to be given a fine
words.example: I need to get a ticket for the 3:00 PM train to Taipei.
words.chinese: 購買車票、電影票等；取得入場券

words.engDef: to no longer know where you are
words.example: The delivery driver got lost in the industrial park and was delayed.
words.chinese: 迷路；找不到方向；（比喻）失去注意力或專注

words.engDef: to leave a bus, train, or plane
words.example: The manager asked the intern to get off the bus at the next stop.
words.chinese: （從交通工具上）下車；離開（工作場所、會議等）

words.engDef: to arrive at a place
words.example: We need to get to the airport by 6:00 AM to catch our flight.
words.chinese: 到達；抵達（某地），（交通工具）能及時到達

words.engDef: a short holiday; also an escape
words.example: We're planning a romantic weekend getaway to the coast.
words.chinese: 短期休假；度假勝地；逃走；逃脫

words.engDef: to take someone somewhere in your vehicle
words.example: Could you give me a ride to the airport tomorrow morning?
words.chinese: 搭乘（某人）的車輛，提供短程的交通服務。

words.engDef: to give a formal talk showing information
words.example: The marketing team will give a presentation on the new product launch next week.
words.chinese: 進行簡報；向大眾發表演講

words.engDef: to tell someone how to get somewhere
words.example: Could you give me directions to the nearest subway station?
words.chinese: 指引方向；提供路線指示

words.engDef: to let other traffic go first
words.example: Vehicles must give way to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
words.chinese: 讓步；優先通行；（交通）讓行

words.engDef: to walk down a set of stairs
words.example: After the conference, attendees are advised to go down the steps and exit through the main lobby.
words.chinese: 沿著樓梯往下走；下樓

words.engDef: to take a holiday away from home
words.example: The company policy allows employees to go on vacation for two weeks each year.
words.chinese: 休假；前往度假

words.engDef: to go directly to a place without stopping
words.example: To reach the conference room, go straight to the fifth floor.
words.chinese: 直接前往；不經過其他步驟或地點

words.engDef: to pass the officials who check goods at a border
words.example: Passengers are required to go through customs after disembarking the plane.
words.chinese: 通過海關；經過海關檢查

words.engDef: a tip given to a waiter, taxi driver, or other service worker
words.example: The restaurant bill includes a fifteen percent gratuity for the service staff.
words.chinese: 小費，小費報酬

words.engDef: a reduced price for a number of people booking together
words.example: We offer a group rate for companies booking more than 10 rooms.
words.chinese: 團體優惠價格；適用於大量預訂或會員的特殊折扣。

words.engDef: a book giving information for travellers
words.example: Before the business trip to Tokyo, the team consulted the guidebook for recommended restaurants and transportation options.
words.chinese: 旅遊指南；提供景點、路線等資訊的書籍或手冊，通常用於旅行規劃。

words.engDef: a visit led by someone who explains what you see
words.example: The conference attendees will have the option of joining a guided tour of the local historical sites.
words.chinese: 由專業導覽員帶領的觀光行程，通常包含詳細解說和特定路線。

words.engDef: with sudden strong bursts of wind
words.example: The flight was delayed due to gusty winds and poor visibility.
words.chinese: 強風；突風，形容風勢強勁且間歇性。

words.engDef: to have a tyre that has lost its air
words.example: I had a flat tire on the way to the airport, which made me miss my flight.
words.chinese: 輪胎爆胎；輪胎失壓

words.engDef: to be able to see a wide or attractive scene
words.example: The hotel room offers a stunning view of the city skyline.
words.chinese: 擁有良好的視野；從某處可看到美麗的景色

words.engDef: to take part in a competition of speed
words.example: Our team will have a race against competitors next month to test our new delivery system.
words.chinese: 進行競賽；參與比賽（通常指體育或賽事）

words.engDef: to move in the direction of a place
words.example: The taxi will head for the airport in about 15 minutes.
words.chinese: 前往；朝向；駛向（某地或某方向）

words.engDef: to move in the direction of something
words.example: The taxi headed toward the airport after picking up the passengers.
words.chinese: 朝向；駛向（某個方向或目的地）

words.engDef: one of the strong lights at the front of a vehicle
words.example: The car's headlights were malfunctioning, making it difficult to see in the fog.
words.chinese: 車頭燈；車燈

words.engDef: a large number of vehicles moving slowly
words.example: Due to heavy traffic, the delivery might be delayed by an hour.
words.chinese: 交通壅塞，車流量大

words.engDef: an aircraft that flies using rotating blades above it
words.example: The rescue team used a helicopter to reach the stranded hikers.
words.chinese: 直升機

words.engDef: a person who walks long distances in the countryside
words.example: The group of hikers enjoyed the scenic trail.
words.chinese: 徒步旅行者；登山者

words.engDef: to keep your hand on the rail for safety
words.example: Please hold onto the handrail while the bus is in motion.
words.chinese: 緊抓扶手，以保持平衡或安全。

words.engDef: the cover over a car's engine
words.example: The mechanic inspected the hood for any signs of damage after the accident.
words.chinese: 引擎蓋；車頭蓋

words.engDef: with the flowers fully open
words.example: The cherry blossoms are in bloom, making it a popular time for tourists to visit Japan.
words.chinese: 盛開的；開花的（指植物）

words.engDef: happening during an aircraft journey
words.example: The in-flight entertainment system offers a wide selection of movies and music.
words.chinese: 飛行中的；在飛行過程中發生的

words.engDef: unpleasantly cold or wet, of weather
words.example: Due to the inclement weather, the flight has been delayed until further notice.
words.chinese: 惡劣的（指天氣）；不適宜的

words.engDef: the introducing of a new element; also a liquid given medically
words.example: The hospital provides intravenous infusions of antibiotics to combat infections.
words.chinese: 注入；（醫學上）靜脈輸液

words.engDef: relating to Ireland or its people
words.example: The company decided to incorporate some Irish charm into their new marketing campaign.
words.chinese: 源自愛爾蘭的；愛爾蘭人的；愛爾蘭風格的

words.engDef: relating to Italy, its people, or its language
words.example: The restaurant offers authentic Italian cuisine.
words.chinese: 源自義大利的；義大利的（人、事物、文化等）

words.engDef: a planned route or journey; a detailed travel plan
words.example: The corporate travel agent prepared a detailed itinerary for the sales director.
words.chinese: 行程表，旅行計劃

words.engDef: the tiredness felt after flying across time zones
words.example: After the long flight to Tokyo, he's suffering from severe jet lag and needs a day to recover.
words.chinese: 時差反應；因跨時區旅行而引起的疲勞和睡眠障礙。

words.engDef: the seventh month of the year
words.example: The annual sales conference is scheduled for July 15th.
words.chinese: 七月，一年中的第七個月。
words.rootPrefix: Julius Caesar (the month renamed after him)

words.engDef: the sixth month of the year
words.example: The annual sales conference is scheduled for June 15th.
words.chinese: 六月，一年中的第六個月。
words.rootPrefix: Junius (the Roman month named for the goddess Juno)

words.engDef: a unit of distance equal to one thousand metres
words.example: The nearest gas station is about five kilometers from here.
words.chinese: 公里 (公尺的一千倍；測量距離的單位)

words.engDef: a tall post in the street with a light on top
words.example: The street was poorly lit, with several lampposts malfunctioning.
words.chinese: 路燈柱；街燈柱

words.engDef: to bring a boat to the quay and tie it up
words.example: The cargo ship is scheduled to land at the dock tomorrow morning.
words.chinese: 靠岸；停靠在碼頭

words.engDef: well-known features that help you know where you are
words.example: The conference venue is near several well-known landmarks, making it easily accessible.
words.chinese: 地標；著名建築或景點，通常用於辨識位置或方向。

words.engDef: a period of rest or waiting before a further stage in a journey
words.example: We had a five-hour layover in Tokyo before our connection flight to Paris.
words.chinese: （途中）短暫停留，轉機停留

words.engDef: to set off towards a place
words.example: The sales team will leave for Tokyo tomorrow morning to attend the industry conference.
words.chinese: 出發前往（某地），通常指為了商務或旅行目的

words.engDef: the space in front of a seat for your legs
words.example: I'm upgrading to a seat with more leg room for the long flight.
words.chinese: 座位空間（尤指飛行器、火車或汽車等交通工具中，腿部可活動的空間）

words.engDef: the registration number shown on a vehicle
words.example: The security guard asked for the license plate number of the vehicle involved in the accident.
words.chinese: 車牌號碼，通常用於識別車輛。

words.engDef: a ring or jacket that keeps a person afloat
words.example: The cruise line requires all passengers to familiarize themselves with the location of the life preservers.
words.chinese: 救生圈；救生浮標

words.english: lock the key in the car
words.engDef: to shut the car with the key still inside
words.example: I accidentally locked the key in the car, and now I'm stranded.
words.chinese: 將鑰匙鎖在車內，導致無法進入車輛。

words.engDef: to pause a journey at a place
words.example: We'll make a brief stop at the service station to refuel the vehicle.
words.chinese: 暫停；停留（通常指短暫的休息或為了特定目的而停下來）

words.engDef: to move something skilfully into position
words.example: The truck driver skillfully maneuvered the vehicle through the narrow city streets.
words.chinese: 巧妙地操作或移動（通常指車輛或設備），以應對特定情況或達成目標。

words.engDef: the tall pole that holds a ship's sails
words.example: The ship's mast was damaged during the storm, delaying the cargo delivery.
words.chinese: 桅杆；船桅

words.engDef: to be at the airport when someone's plane arrives
words.example: Our airport representative will meet your flight upon arrival and escort you to the hotel.
words.chinese: 在機場接送或與航班同步，確保乘客能按時登機。

words.engDef: the middle of summer, around the longest day
words.example: Many tourists visit Scandinavia during midsummer to experience the long daylight hours.
words.chinese: 仲夏節（北歐傳統節日，通常指 6 月 21 日或 24 日）；夏季中旬
words.rootPrefix: mid- (middle) + summa (the top -- Romans added the column upward and wrote the total at the top) + -er

words.engDef: the distance travelled, measured in miles
words.example: The company offers a reimbursement policy for business mileage.
words.chinese: 里程數；行駛距離（通常指車輛的行駛里程）

words.engDef: bags that have not arrived with their owner
words.example: The airline is responsible for compensating passengers for their missing luggage.
words.chinese: 遺失行李；未找到的行李

words.engDef: the sick feeling caused by travelling in a vehicle
words.example: Many passengers on the cruise ship suffered from motion sickness during the rough seas.
words.chinese: 暈車症，指因交通工具的晃動或移動而引起的噁心、頭暈等不適感。

words.engDef: so good or interesting that you should not miss it
words.example: This museum is a must-see attraction for anyone visiting the city.
words.chinese: 必看（的）、不可錯過的（事物或體驗），通常指具有高度推薦價值的事物。

words.engDef: a place open late at night for dancing and drinks
words.example: Our marketing campaign aims to attract a younger demographic to the nightclub.
words.chinese: 夜總會，通常提供音樂、舞蹈和酒精飲料的娛樂場所。

words.engDef: the entertainment available in a place in the evening
words.example: The city is known for its vibrant nightlife, attracting tourists from around the world.
words.chinese: 夜生活，指夜晚的娛樂活動，通常與酒吧、俱樂部、餐廳等場所相關。

words.engDef: a person who does not arrive for a reservation or booking
words.example: The hotel charges a penalty fee for any no-show bookings on weekends.
words.chinese: 已預訂但未到者

words.engDef: not able to be paid back if you cancel
words.example: The airline ticket is nonrefundable, so please double-check your travel dates before booking.
words.chinese: 不可退費的；無法退還的

words.engDef: a flight that goes straight there without landing
words.example: To save time, I booked a nonstop flight from New York to London.
words.chinese: 直飛航班，不經中途停靠的航班

words.engDef: relating to Norway, its people, or its language
words.example: The company is exploring potential partnerships with Norwegian firms specializing in renewable energy.
words.chinese: 挪威的；挪威人的；挪威語的

words.engDef: quite close to
words.example: The hotel is not far from the convention center, making it a convenient choice for attendees.
words.chinese: 離...不遠；距離...很近

words.engDef: a long pole with a flat blade used to row a boat
words.example: The rowing team needs to replace their old oars before the competition.
words.chinese: 槳；划槳

words.engDef: the tenth month of the year
words.example: The annual sales conference is scheduled for October 15th.
words.chinese: 十月，一年中的第十個月。
words.rootPrefix: octo (eight) -> the eighth month of the old Roman year

words.engDef: in the water a short distance from land
words.example: The cruise ship anchored just off the shore, allowing passengers to enjoy the scenic view.
words.chinese: 在海岸線附近，但不在海岸線上；離岸

words.engDef: at times when demand is lower and prices cheaper
words.example: The train ticket is cheaper during off-peak hours.
words.chinese: 非尖峰時段；離峰時段（通常指交通、能源或服務的價格較低的時間段）

words.engDef: the part of the year when few tourists travel
words.example: The hotel offers discounted rates during the off-season to attract more visitors.
words.chinese: 淡季；非旅遊旺季

words.engDef: by walking
words.example: Due to the strike, employees are advised to commute to work on foot.
words.chinese: 步行；靠雙腳移動

words.engDef: away from work and travelling for pleasure
words.example: Mr. Smith will be on vacation for two weeks, starting next Monday.
words.chinese: 休假，度假

words.engDef: a ticket for a journey in one direction only
words.example: I need a one-way ticket to New York for tomorrow morning.
words.chinese: 單程票，指只能搭乘一次的車票，通常不允許轉乘或退費。

words.engDef: away from the town where you live or work
words.example: I'm out of town on a business trip next week, so I'm not available to attend the meeting.
words.chinese: 不在本地，前往其他城市或國家旅行或居住。

words.engDef: over the side of a ship into the water
words.example: During the storm, a crate of supplies was washed overboard.
words.chinese: （船隻或飛機上）掉入海中或掉下機艙外；（比喻）失去控制或失去職位。
words.rootPrefix: over (over the side) + board (a ship's side)

words.engDef: to accept more reservations than there are places available
words.example: The airline had to offer travel vouchers because they overbooked the flight.
words.chinese: 超額預訂

words.engDef: the shelf above the seats for hand luggage
words.example: Please store your carry-on luggage in the overhead rack for safety during the flight.
words.chinese: 行李架；頭頂置物空間（通常指飛機或火車上的），用於存放乘客的行李。

words.engDef: a road or bridge that crosses above another road
words.example: The new overpass significantly reduced traffic congestion during rush hour.
words.chinese: 高架橋，涵洞（通常指跨越道路或鐵路的橋樑，用於交通疏導）
words.rootPrefix: over- (too much) + passus (a step, a pace)

words.engDef: to go past something without stopping
words.example: The delivery truck will pass by the warehouse at approximately 3 PM.
words.chinese: 經過；沿著...而過；略過（不予處理或關注）

words.engDef: people travelling in a vehicle who are not the driver
words.example: The airline announced a delay due to inclement weather, affecting hundreds of passengers.
words.chinese: 乘客；旅客

words.engDef: the paved path at the side of a road
words.example: Construction workers are repairing the pavement after the recent storm.
words.chinese: 人行道；人行步道（通常指用混凝土或石塊鋪設的區域）

words.engDef: people who are walking rather than driving
words.example: The pedestrian crossing is for people on foot to safely cross the street.
words.chinese: 行人；步行者（通常指在道路上行走的個人或群體）

words.engDef: the personal belongings someone carries with them
words.example: Please declare your personal effects at customs upon arrival.
words.chinese: 個人物品，通常指旅行或出差時攜帶的私人物品。

words.engDef: the fuel used in cars, called gasoline in America
words.example: I need to stop at the next station to get some petrol.
words.chinese: 汽油 (主要用於英國英語)

words.engDef: to collect someone or something; also to learn casually
words.example: Could you pick me up at the airport at 6:00 AM tomorrow?
words.chinese: （撿取）拾取；（接）載取；（理解）領悟；（改善）提升

words.engDef: to collect travellers and take them on board
words.example: The taxi driver will pick up passengers from the airport at 6 AM.
words.chinese: 接載乘客；載客

words.engDef: a person who flies an aircraft
words.example: The airline requires all pilots to undergo regular safety training.
words.chinese: 飛行員；駕駛員（通常指飛機或船舶的駕駛員）
words.rootPrefix: pedon (an oar, a rudder, Greek) -> the one who steers

words.engDef: a paved public walk, especially beside the sea
words.example: After the conference, attendees enjoyed a leisurely promenade along the beach.
words.chinese: （尤其指在海邊或公園等地方的）散步、閒逛；（正式場合的）遊行
words.rootPrefix: pro- (forth) + minare (to drive) + -ade -> a driving forward, a stroll

words.engDef: the buses, trains, and other services open to everyone
words.example: The company encourages employees to use public transportation to reduce carbon emissions.
words.chinese: 公共交通系統，指由政府或私人機構運營，向公眾開放的交通工具，如巴士、火車、地鐵等。

words.engDef: to drive a vehicle into a place and stop
words.example: The taxi pulled into the hotel driveway.
words.chinese: 駛入（車輛）；停靠（車輛）

words.engDef: the officer on a ship or plane in charge of accounts and service
words.example: The purser is responsible for all financial transactions and passenger services on board the ship.
words.chinese: 事務長；管事；（船隻、客機等的）座艙長，空服經理

words.engDef: the metal track trains run on; also travel by train
words.example: The train was delayed due to a problem with the rails.
words.chinese: 軌道；鐵軌；（比喻）限制、束縛
words.rootPrefix: regula (a straight stick, a rule) -> rail

words.engDef: a thick tropical forest with very heavy rainfall
words.example: The company is committed to sustainable tourism, minimizing the impact on fragile ecosystems like the Amazon rain forest.
words.chinese: 熱帶雨林，指降雨量豐富、植被茂盛的熱帶地區。

words.engDef: a short period of rain
words.example: The meeting was briefly interrupted by a rain shower, but we resumed shortly after.
words.chinese: 短暫的降雨，通常指持續時間較短且強度適中的降雨。

words.engDef: a person who looks after a park or forest
words.example: The park rangers are responsible for ensuring visitor safety and protecting the wildlife.
words.chinese: 巡邏員；保護員（通常指國家公園或自然保護區的巡邏人員，負責維護秩序、保護生態環境）

words.engDef: able to be paid back if you cancel
words.example: The hotel offers fully refundable rates, allowing guests to cancel their reservation without penalty.
words.chinese: 可退還的；可以退款的

words.engDef: a car hired for a short period
words.example: The company policy allows employees to use rental cars for business trips.
words.chinese: 租賃汽車；租車服務

words.engDef: to leave on a bicycle, horse, or motorbike
words.example: After the conference, the CEO rode away in a limousine.
words.chinese: 騎離；駛離（某地或某人）

words.engDef: the number of people who use a transport service
words.example: The company is investing in new trains to increase ridership on the subway line.
words.chinese: 客流量；搭乘人數（通常指公共交通工具）

words.engDef: a notice beside a road giving drivers information
words.example: Drivers should pay close attention to road signs to avoid accidents.
words.chinese: 道路標誌；交通標誌，用以指示駕駛者或行人注意安全及遵守交通規則的標誌。

words.engDef: repair work being done on a road
words.example: Due to roadworks on the highway, expect delays of up to 30 minutes.
words.chinese: 道路施工；道路維修工程

words.engDef: to move about a place with no fixed plan
words.example: During the conference break, attendees are free to roam around the exhibition hall.
words.chinese: 漫遊、四處走動（通常沒有特定目的地，用於探索或休閒），在特定區域內自由活動。

words.engDef: a journey to a place and back again
words.example: The company offers a discounted round trip airfare for employees attending the conference.
words.chinese: 往返票；環島旅行

words.engDef: the ways taken to get from one place to another
words.example: The delivery company is exploring new routes to reduce transportation costs.
words.chinese: 路線；航線；途徑

words.engDef: the remains of buildings that have fallen down
words.example: The archaeological team is excavating the ancient ruins to uncover historical artifacts.
words.chinese: 廢墟；殘跡（通常指建築物或城市，暗示過去的繁榮或重要性）

words.engDef: the strip of ground where aircraft take off and land
words.example: The flight was delayed due to runway maintenance.
words.chinese: 跑道，飛機起降用的跑道。

words.engDef: the times of day when traffic is heaviest
words.example: Due to rush hour, the delivery is expected to be delayed by at least an hour.
words.chinese: 交通尖峰時段，通常指上下班期間道路交通擁擠的時間。

words.engDef: a trip to see wild animals in their natural surroundings
words.example: Our company is organizing a corporate safari to boost team morale and foster a sense of adventure.
words.chinese: （非洲）野生動物考察之旅；（引申）深入探索、考察

words.engDef: to travel over water in a boat using sails
words.example: The company is offering a training program for employees to learn how to sail small boats.
words.chinese: 駕駛船隻；航行（船隻）

words.engDef: the day after Friday
words.example: The marketing team will finalize the campaign report on Saturday.
words.chinese: 星期六，週六；通常指週末前的最後一天，在商務情境中可能指週末休假或安排非工作相關活動的日子。

words.engDef: the sick feeling caused by the movement of a boat
words.example: Several passengers complained of seasickness during the rough crossing.
words.chinese: 暈船病；因海上旅程引起的噁心、頭暈等不適症狀。

words.engDef: the area beside the sea, especially as a holiday place
words.example: We enjoyed a lovely walk along the seaside.
words.chinese: 海邊; 海濱

words.engDef: the number of people a place can seat
words.example: The conference hall has a seating capacity of 300 attendees.
words.chinese: 容納人數；座位數量

words.engDef: a car with a separate boot and seats for four or more
words.example: The company offers a free shuttle service in a luxury sedan for its VIP clients.
words.chinese: 轎車；（美）四門汽車
words.rootPrefix: sedere (to sit) -> a chair you sit in

words.engDef: to begin a journey
words.example: The company set out to increase market share by 10% this quarter.
words.chinese: 開始前往；啟程前往（通常指為了達成某個目標）

words.engDef: homes for older people with staff and support nearby
words.example: The company is developing a new complex of sheltered housing to cater to the growing elderly population.
words.chinese: 為老年人或有特殊需求者提供的，設有照護和支援服務的住宅。

words.engDef: a regular transport service operating between two designated places
words.example: The hotel provides a complimentary shuttle service to and from the airport.
words.chinese: 接駁服務

words.engDef: a long narrow board fastened to a boot for gliding on snow
words.example: We're planning a ski trip to the Alps this winter.
words.chinese: 滑雪板；滑雪運動；滑雪
words.rootPrefix: skith (a stick of wood, Old Norse)

words.engDef: the direction between south and east
words.example: The company's new distribution center is located in the southeast region of the country.
words.chinese: 東南方向；東南區域

words.engDef: a place offering health and beauty treatments
words.example: The company offers employees a voucher for a relaxing spa treatment as part of their wellness program.
words.chinese: 水療中心，提供按摩、美容等放鬆身心療程的機構。
words.rootPrefix: Spa (the Belgian town famous for its mineral springs)

words.engDef: buildings where horses are kept
words.example: The company is working to stabilize its financial situation after the recent market downturn.
words.chinese: 馬廍；穩定的狀態或情況

words.engDef: a carved or cast figure of a person or animal
words.example: The hotel lobby features a magnificent statue of the city's founder.
words.chinese: 雕像；雕塑品，通常是人物或事件的紀念物。

words.engDef: the wheel a driver turns to guide a vehicle
words.example: The driver gripped the steering wheel tightly as he navigated the winding mountain road.
words.chinese: 方向盤；轉向盤（汽車等車輛的控制裝置）

words.engDef: to halt at a set of traffic lights
words.example: The delivery driver had to stop at a light, causing a slight delay.
words.chinese: 在紅綠燈前停車

words.engDef: to break a journey in order to refuel
words.example: We need to stop for fuel before we reach the next town; the gas gauge is almost on empty.
words.chinese: 為了加油而暫停（行駛），通常指車輛在旅途中為了補充燃料而停車。

words.engDef: to break a journey and stay somewhere for a while
words.example: Due to the flight delay, we had to stop over in Frankfurt for three hours.
words.chinese: 中途停留；短暫停留（通常指旅行途中）

words.engDef: a break in a journey, especially on an international flight
words.example: She planned a brief two-day stopover in Dubai on her way home to London.
words.chinese: 中途停留

words.engDef: to put something away tidily in a space
words.example: Passengers are requested to stow their carry-on luggage in the overhead compartments.
words.chinese: 將物品收納、存放（通常指在飛機、船隻等交通工具上）；儲藏

words.engDef: a sign showing the name of a street or giving directions
words.example: Please pay attention to the street signs to avoid getting lost in the city.
words.chinese: 路標；街道標誌，用以指示方向、警告注意或提供資訊的標誌。

words.engDef: a passenger vehicle that runs on rails through streets
words.example: The company is considering a new streetcar line to improve access to the business district.
words.chinese: 有軌電車，通常指在城市中行走的公共交通工具。

words.engDef: going high above the earth but not into full orbit
words.example: The company is developing a suborbital flight service for tourists.
words.chinese: 亞軌道（飛行）；指飛行器達到亞軌道速度，但未進入軌道，通常用於短時間的太空旅行。

words.engDef: regular payments made to receive a service
words.example: The company offers various subscription plans for its online magazine.
words.chinese: 訂閱；定期付費服務

words.engDef: a rail route linking a city with its outer areas
words.example: The company is considering extending the suburban train line to accommodate the growing residential area.
words.chinese: 郊區鐵路系統，通常指連接市中心與郊區住宅區的通勤鐵路。

words.engDef: an underground railway in a city
words.example: Our new office is located next to a subway station, which makes daily commuting easier for staff.
words.chinese: 地下鐵；城市內部的快速公共運輸系統，常用於通勤或商務出行。

words.engDef: a place where underground trains stop for passengers
words.example: The conference venue is conveniently located near the subway station.
words.chinese: 地鐵站；捷運站，通常指城市地下鐵路系統的停靠點。

words.engDef: the warmest season of the year
words.example: Our company offers discounted rates for summer travel packages.
words.chinese: 夏季；暑假，指一年中最熱的季節，通常與休假和旅遊相關。
words.rootPrefix: summa (the top -- Romans added the column upward and wrote the total at the top) + -er

words.engDef: dark glasses worn to protect the eyes from the sun
words.example: The company provides employees with complimentary sunglasses for outdoor events.
words.chinese: 太陽眼鏡；遮陽鏡，通常用於保護眼睛免受陽光照射。

words.engDef: the natural light that comes from the sun
words.example: The office building's design maximizes sunlight to reduce energy consumption.
words.chinese: 陽光；日光，尤其指透過窗戶或建築物進入的光線。

words.engDef: a cream that protects the skin from the sun
words.example: Always apply sunscreen before going out in the sun to protect your skin.
words.chinese: 防曬乳；防曬霜；防曬油

words.engDef: the time when the sun goes down
words.example: The hotel offers stunning sunset views from every room.
words.chinese: 日落；黃昏，指太陽落下地平線時的景象，通常用於描述美景或營造浪漫氛圍。

words.engDef: a large vehicle suitable for rough roads
words.example: The company is considering purchasing a fleet of SUVs for its sales team to improve their mobility in various terrains.
words.chinese: 運動型多功能車 (SUV) 是一種結合了轎車的舒適性和休旅車的載貨能力的車輛。

words.engDef: to go on an organised visit to see a place
words.example: The conference attendees are encouraged to take a tour of the local historical sites.
words.chinese: 參觀旅遊行程；參加導覽

words.engDef: to have a holiday away from work
words.example: After a demanding quarter, employees are encouraged to take a vacation to recharge.
words.chinese: 休假；休養（通常指較長期的休閒時段，用於恢復身心或進行旅行）

words.engDef: to go for a short walk
words.example: After a stressful meeting, I decided to take a walk around the block to clear my head.
words.chinese: 散步，短途步行（通常為休閒或放鬆目的）

words.engDef: to leave the ground, as an aircraft does
words.example: The flight will take off from Gate 12 at 10:00 AM.
words.chinese: （飛機）起飛；（衣服）脫下；（休假）請假

words.engDef: small pegs on which a golf ball is placed
words.example: The golfer placed his ball on a new tee before his second shot.
words.chinese: 高爾夫球旗桿上的T字，用於固定球旗。

words.engDef: an informal spelling of through
words.example: The delivery truck will drive thru the industrial park to reach the warehouse.
words.chinese: 穿過；透過；從...經過

words.engDef: to fasten a boat to a post or ring with rope
words.example: The dockworker carefully tied the boat to the pier to prevent it from drifting away.
words.chinese: 將船纜繫住船隻

words.engDef: the charge for using a road or bridge
words.example: The company will reimburse employees for toll prices incurred during business trips.
words.chinese: 通行費；過路費（通常指高速公路或橋樑的收費）

words.engDef: to land, as an aircraft does
words.example: The pilot announced that the plane would touch down in ten minutes.
words.chinese: （飛機等）安全降落；實際降落（指飛機觸地）

words.engDef: a coach used to carry sightseers
words.example: The tour bus will depart from the hotel lobby at 8:00 AM sharp.
words.chinese: 旅遊巴士，通常指為觀光客提供服務的大型巴士。

words.engDef: people who travel to visit places for pleasure
words.example: The hotel is expecting a large influx of tourists during the holiday season.
words.chinese: 觀光客；遊客（通常指旅行或度假的人）

words.engDef: a business that pulls broken-down vehicles away
words.example: Our insurance policy covers the cost of a towing service if your car breaks down.
words.chinese: 拖車服務，指提供拖曳故障車輛或被拖曳物體的專業服務。

words.engDef: a build-up of vehicles that slows movement
words.example: The company is considering implementing flexible work hours to reduce traffic congestion during peak commuting times.
words.chinese: 交通擁塞，指車流量過大導致車輛行進緩慢或停滯的狀況。

words.engDef: a long line of vehicles that cannot move freely
words.example: The heavy traffic jam caused the delivery to be delayed by two hours.
words.chinese: 交通壅塞，特別指車輛因數量過多而導致的長時間停滯現象。

words.engDef: a set of coloured lights that controls traffic
words.example: The delivery truck was delayed due to a malfunctioning traffic light.
words.chinese: 交通號誌；紅綠燈

words.engDef: a light or sign that controls the movement of traffic
words.example: Drivers must obey the traffic signals to ensure safety.
words.chinese: 交通號誌；紅綠燈

words.engDef: the member of staff in charge on a train
words.example: The train conductor announced a 15-minute delay due to track maintenance.
words.chinese: 列車長，負責列車運行的管理人員，負責乘客安全、票務管理和列車運行。

words.engDef: a business that arranges journeys and holidays
words.example: Our company has partnered with a reputable travel agency to arrange business trips for our employees.
words.chinese: 旅行社，專營旅遊服務的機構，協助客戶規劃、預訂和安排旅行。

words.engDef: a plan made for a journey
words.example: The travel agency is handling all the travel arrangements for the conference attendees.
words.chinese: 行程安排；旅行預訂

words.engDef: a person who is on a journey
words.example: The hotel offers special rates for business travelers.
words.chinese: 旅客；旅行者（通常指因商務或休閒目的旅行的人）

words.engDef: passages dug under the ground or through a hill
words.example: The construction company is responsible for maintaining the safety and efficiency of the highway tunnels.
words.chinese: 隧道；地下通道（通常用於交通運輸或地下設施）

words.engDef: rough movement of air that shakes an aircraft
words.example: The pilot announced that we would be experiencing moderate turbulence during the flight.
words.chinese: （尤指飛行中）亂流；動盪不安的狀態

words.engDef: below the surface of the ground; also a city rail system
words.example: The company is exploring the possibility of building an underground parking facility.
words.chinese: 地下的；位於地下的；（交通）地鐵

words.engDef: below the surface of the water
words.example: The company is exploring the possibility of underwater construction for the new port facility.
words.chinese: 水下的；位於水面以下的

words.engDef: a holiday sold with travel and accommodation together
words.example: Our company offers vacation packages to popular destinations in Southeast Asia.
words.chinese: 度假套裝行程，通常包含交通、住宿和活動，以優惠價格提供。

words.engDef: a person who parks cars for guests or cleans clothes in a hotel
words.example: He handed his car keys to the hotel valet before entering the lobby.
words.chinese: 代客泊車員；侍從

words.engDef: to wait until places are free to sit down
words.example: We'll need to wait for seats at the restaurant before we can be seated.
words.chinese: 等待座位，通常指在餐廳、電影院等場所等待空位。

words.engDef: near enough to reach on foot
words.example: The hotel is within walking distance of the convention center, making it a convenient choice for attendees.
words.chinese: 步行可達的距離；在步行距離內

words.engDef: an organised visit to a place made on foot
words.example: Our company offers walking tours of the historic downtown area for visiting clients.
words.chinese: 由導覽員帶領的步行觀光行程，通常包含歷史、文化或特定主題的介紹。

words.engDef: a statement of what the weather is expected to be
words.example: The weather forecast predicts heavy rain tomorrow, so the outdoor event has been postponed.
words.chinese: 天氣預報；氣象預測，通常指未來一段時間的天氣狀況預測。

words.engDef: an account of what the weather is or will be
words.example: Before your business trip, be sure to check the weather report for potential delays.
words.chinese: 天氣預報；氣象報告

words.engDef: the coldest season of the year
words.example: Due to the severe winter weather, all flights to Chicago have been canceled.
words.chinese: 冬季；寒冷的季節

words.engDef: the blade that clears rain from a vehicle's windscreen
words.example: The car's wipers weren't working well during the heavy rain.
words.chinese: 雨刷；擦拭器
